It decides which resource it wants (want_comm or want_drive), gets ready (ready), asks the arbiter (request_comm or request_drive) and waits for the answer. A denial sends it back to ready. Once granted (s1 or s2 = 3), it uses the resource (use): with probability x = 0.01 it keeps it (= 4) and must give it back (cancel); with probability 0.99 it becomes idle without telling the arbiter, so the arbiter and the monitor still count the resource as its own.
